rules.accepted_credit_types: Clinical courses (e.g. oral surgery, endodontics, pharmacology, professional ethics); other subjects only if clinically relevant; Board does not pre-approve courses; online without limit
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed in an even year: 8 h (incl. the 3 h controlled substances) at the next renewal; licensed in an odd year: no CE at the first renewal.
rules.audit_note: Random audit; keep records 4 years after the renewal period and produce them within 30 days of notice.

topics.who: Responsible prescribing of controlled substances; cannot be waived
Current BLS; does not count toward the 16 h

rules.notes: Two-year CE periods end Dec 31 of odd years (2024-2025, 2026-2027). Current BLS required separately and does not count toward the 16 h. No practice-building or business courses.
rules.legal_basis: Wyoming Board of Dental Examiners Rules, Chapter 3
rules.rule_quote: Sixteen (16) hours are due every two years.
